ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a small cart labeled A, and a person is standing on the small cart; on the right side is a small cart labeled B. The two carts are on the same horizontal track, the arrow above A is labeled v0 and points to the right, and the arrow above B is labeled v0 and points to the left. Reasoning: Take rightward as the positive direction. The problem gives that the mass of each small cart is 30 kg, the mass of the person is 40 kg, and the initial speed is v0 = 2 m/s. Let the person's horizontal speed relative to the ground when jumping from A to B be u. At the instant the person jumps from A, apply conservation of momentum in the horizontal direction to the system composed of A and the person: 30 v_A + 40 u = (30 + 40)·2. After the person lands on B, apply conservation of momentum to the system composed of B and the person: 30·(-2) + 40 u = (30 + 40) v_B. To avoid collision of the two carts, the critical minimum case is that after the person gets onto B, A no longer catches up with B, that is, v_A = v_B. From the first equation v_A = (140 - 40u)/30, and from the second equation v_B = (40u - 60)/70. Set the two equal: (140 - 40u)/30 = (40u - 60)/70, solving gives 9800 - 2800u = 1200u - 1800, so 11600 = 4000u, u = 2.9 m/s.

raw_record.question_text:
There are two carts, A and B, each with a mass of $30\mathrm{kg}$, moving on a smooth horizontal surface at the same speed of $2\mathrm{m/s}$ along the same straight line but in opposite directions. There is a person with a mass of $40\mathrm{kg}$ on cart A.

What is the minimum horizontal speed (relative to the ground) that the person must jump from cart A to cart B to avoid a collision between the two carts?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: cart A is on the left with the person standing on it, cart B is on the right, both on a horizontal track; the arrows labeled v0 show A moving right and B moving left. From the text, take each cart as 30 kg, the person as 40 kg, and v0 = 2 m/s. Let right be positive and let u be the person's horizontal ground speed when jumping toward B. Use momentum conservation for the takeoff from A: 30 v_A + 40 u = (30+40)2. Use momentum conservation for the landing on B: 30(-2) + 40u = (30+40)v_B. To avoid collision, after the person is on B the left cart A must not be catching the right cart B; the minimum case is the boundary v_A = v_B. Solve these three relations to get u = 2.9 m/s.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一辆标有 A 的小车，小车上站着一个人；右侧是一辆标有 B 的小车。两车在同一水平轨道上，A 上方的箭头标为 v0 且指向右方，B 上方的箭头标为 v0 且指向左方。

推理：取向右为正方向。题给每辆小车质量为 30 kg，人的质量为 40 kg，初速 v0 = 2 m/s。设人从 A 跳向 B 时相对地面的水平速度为 u。人从 A 起跳瞬间，对 A 与人组成的系统应用水平方向动量守恒：30 v_A + 40 u = (30 + 40)·2。人落到 B 上后，对 B 与人组成的系统应用动量守恒：30·(-2) + 40 u = (30 + 40) v_B。为避免两车碰撞，临界最小情况是人上到 B 后，A 不再追上 B，即 v_A = v_B。由第一式 v_A = (140 - 40u)/30，由第二式 v_B = (40u - 60)/70。令二者相等：(140 - 40u)/30 = (40u - 60)/70，解得 9800 - 2800u = 1200u - 1800，所以 11600 = 4000u，u = 2.9 m/s。
